Mod.name: JENGA
Mod.description:
JENGA!
JENGA completely changes the way you progress through Noita.
Instead of collecting every wand you find, each world wand becomes a source of a single spell. Build your favorite wands over the course of a run by salvaging spells and creating your own always cast combinations.
World wands are never kept unless picked up into an empty slot. Otherwise, they are dismantled, leaving behind only a single spell to strengthen one of your existing wands.
Unwanted wands can be stored on the JENGA stack found in almost every Holy Mountain. But don't let the pile grow too high... abandoned wands have a habit of waking up.
Features Two gameplay modes: Random and Normal Random Mode keeps one random spell from every world wand Normal Mode lets you choose exactly which spell to salvage Permanently bound spells cannot be removed or rearranged JENGA stacks appear in almost every Holy Mountain Wand ghosts may emerge from oversized stacks Hold Left Alt while hovering a wand to inspect permanently bound spells
Remember: Every wand is temporary. Every spell is forever.
